column1: # p429 · 2026-10-25 · THE CREDENTIAL-PROVISIONING CENSUS — the measurement `Gap 428-E` asked for.
# `Gap 428-E` was opened by p428 as: the token assumption under every LMS-agent recipe on these shelves is unmeasured, and TWO READMEs say it fails.
# Two READMEs is an anecdote.  This is the same question asked of 46 README payloads across two whole cohorts, each read at the SHA on 2026-10-25.
# Classification is by what the README REQUIRES OF THE OPERATOR, read from the payload — never from the author's name or the repo's title:
#   DEV-GCP-OAUTH      = the operator must create their OWN Google Cloud OAuth client (`credentials.json`, console.cloud.google.com, client_secret).
#   INST-DEVELOPER-KEY = the operator needs a key the INSTITUTION registers on their behalf (Blackboard REST application / Application ID).
#   BROWSER-AUTOMATION = the server drives a real browser (Playwright/Puppeteer/Selenium) instead of calling the API.
#   SSO-SESSION        = the server reuses a session the human already signed into (SSO/SAML/Okta/session cookie).
#   UNSTATED           = the README does not say.  Recorded as unstated, NOT as absent — an unread requirement is not a missing one.
# 🔵 This measures what BUILDERS DO, which is revealed preference, not what an institution would grant if asked.  The gap stays open on that half.
